tools.name: discover_seed_docs
tools.description: Discover all available SEED Design documentation sections and categories. Call this first to understand the documentation structure before using list_docs or get_doc.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List available documents in a SEED Design documentation section. Use discover_seed_docs first to see all available sections and categories.

section.description: Documentation section: react, docs, breeze, ai-integration, or lynx

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get the content of a specific SEED Design document. Use list_docs first to see available documents and their paths.

section.description: Documentation section: react, docs, breeze, ai-integration, or lynx

tools.name: get_full_docs
tools.description: Get all documents from a section combined into a single text. Useful for comprehensive analysis or when you need complete context.

section.description: Documentation section: react, docs, breeze, ai-integration, or lynx

tools.name: get_rootage
tools.description: Get SEED Design rootage specification. Use without path to get index (available resources list). Use with path to get specific resource (e.g., '/color.json', '/components/action-button.json').

path.description: Resource path from index.json (e.g., '/color.json', '/components/action-button.json'). Omit to get index with all available paths.

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List available SEED Design icons with optional filtering by type, variant, or service

type.description: Filter by icon type. Monochrome icons are single-color, multicolor are service icons.

variant.description: Filter monochrome icons by variant (line or fill style).

service.description: Filter multicolor icons by service category (e.g., '중고거래', '부동산', '알바').

limit.description: Maximum number of icons to return (default: 50, max: 200).

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search SEED Design icons by keyword. Supports both English and Korean queries.

type.description: Optional: filter results by icon type.

tools.name: get_icon_details
tools.description: Get complete details for a specific SEED icon including React component import and documentation link.
